احلوليت (form XII)
# اِحْلَوْلَيْتُ (iḥlawlaytu) /iħ.law.laj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْلَوْلَى (iḥlawlā)
# اِحْلَوْلَيْتَ (iḥlawlayta) /iħ.law.laj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْلَوْلَى (iḥlawlā)
# اِحْلَوْلَيْتِ (iḥlawlayti) /iħ.law.laj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْلَوْلَى (iḥlawlā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
